consumer: The offline map-dump writer that records each nearby tile's true underlying terrain id; it asks 'what is the raw terrain id at this tile?' and stores it, performing no engine check on the value.
scope: a map region (the raw terrain id of every nearby tile in the export window)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles writes ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() straight into the JSON as ground-truth state, neither computing a yes/no predicate nor applying a display/visibility filter.
divergence: A tile the character has not seen (or remembers stale) whose true map::ter differs from the player's memorized/displayed terrain: class S must report the real underlying id, so a D-style memorized/filtered value would be the wrong answer.
